name: monetready
description: The open-source product forge - turn raw ideas into revenue-ready products

scripts.build: npm run sync && npm run build -w @monetready/core && npm run build -w monetready-cli && npm run build -w create-monetready
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @monetready/core && npm run build -w @monetready/web
scripts.publish:packages: npm run build && npm publish -w @monetready/core --access public && npm publish -w monetready-cli && npm publish -w create-monetready
